items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: I played with Peter Williams. Played with the advertisement.

ctx.x: We're going to say, when was the last time you played in that Buddhist man on that track? Oh, gee. It's been quite a while now. I don't know. I was wondering what happened.

Because I used to play every year. Somebody had to play on the track, advertisement, you know. But the last time, yes, I had to meet some boys. Yeah, I played with Peter Williams. Played with the advertisement. Peter Williams. I think this was for a picnic that was going on the next Sunday. Peter Williams. Peter Williams. Peter Williams. And who else he had playing with him? And then I would play that advertisement all uptown. We left around Jackson Avenue and Galveston. And we went all over uptown. We didn't…
I see quite a few on the carnival day that have bands on the parade. Not so many the last carnival or last year or two, but before that I've had quite a few.
